entradas.text: Lucian and I, together with project leads Symon and Lileas, met to discuss how to proceed.
“Image is everything, Symon. I agree this would bolster the President's reputation.”
The day before the grand opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway, we arrived in Lachaven to begin preparations.
“I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. The highway speaks for itself."
It was a great victory for my administration.
“I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”
entradas.menu: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”

entradas.text: “I agree. I'll hit the road."
entradas.menu: “I agree. I'll hit the road."

entradas.text: “The people will be satisfied. More importantly, so will businesses."
“Sounds good. It would display unity and strength if we were all together in the convoy.”
“Very well.”
“Of course. We'll hold the ceremony and open the highway to the public immediately after.”
“Additionally, a large crowd has been invited to the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”
“It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entradas.menu: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entradas.text: “Like the good old campaign days.”
entradas.menu: “Like the good old campaign days.”

entradas.text: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entradas.menu: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entradas.text: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do. See you in the morning.”
We dispersed to begin our individual preparations for the big day.
I gave Lucian the green light and the opening address began.
entradas.menu: Signal for Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entradas.text: The next morning, a stage had been erected next to the entrance of the highway in downtown Lachaven.
“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”
“Thank you, Mr. President. Lachaven! It is great to be here today among you industrious people.”
“Thanks, Mr. President.”
We took our places onstage.
“People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: Lucian's voice echoed in the square next to the highway. Hundreds of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the cheers intensified.
“Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”
“Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway.”

entradas.text: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: I walked to the podium to address the crowd. Cameras flashed around me.
entradas.menu: Walk up to the podium.

entradas.text: The chanting from the crowd intensified. Some were yelling the motto of Lachaven: Liberty until eternity.
The chanting from the crowd continued.
“At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entradas.menu: “At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entradas.text: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”
entradas.menu: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”

entradas.text: “The aim with the H-3 was to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”
entradas.menu: “The aim with the H-3 was to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”

entradas.text: “Our intention with the H-3 was to ensure citizens an easier commute between Lachaven and Arvory.”
entradas.menu: “Our intention with the H-3 was to ensure citizens an easier commute between Lachaven and Arvory.”

entradas.text: As soon as we left, the highway opened to the public and thousands began using it.
“None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my Interior Minister Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my Interior Minister Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “I must thank the brilliant mind behind the highway project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “I must thank the brilliant mind behind the highway project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “After we cut that ribbon and you drive on the highway, you can judge our success for yourself.”
“United we stand and divided we fall.”
“Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals. I made it my personal priority."
entradas.menu: “Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals. I made it my personal priority."

entradas.text: Lileas walked up to me and leaned into the microphone.
Symon walked up to me.
I cut the ribbon, triggering cheers from the crowd.
entradas.menu: Cut the ribbon.

entradas.text: “Congratulations to all. Hopefully this is one of many successes to come."
“It's a good moment indeed. It gives us pride as a nation. One big step forward."
“Your car is ready.”
A 40-meter-long red ribbon stretched across it.
“This highway has brought and will continue to bring thousands of new jobs."
entradas.menu: “This highway has brought and will continue to bring thousands of new jobs."

entradas.text: “Thanks to this highway, travel between Lachaven and Arvory is twice as fast and infinitely more comfortable."
entradas.menu: “Thanks to this highway, travel between Lachaven and Arvory is twice as fast and infinitely more comfortable."

entradas.text: I entered the car and sat in the driver's seat. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me through the window.
entradas.menu: Enter the car.

entradas.text: “I'd like Lileas with me.”
entradas.menu: “I'd like Lileas with me.”

entradas.text: “I will drive the car on my own.”
entradas.menu: “I will drive the car on my own.”

entradas.text: “I'm honored. It will be lovely to arrive in Arvory with the President of Sordland.”
“I want to have Symon in the lead car.”
entradas.menu: “I want to have Symon in the lead car.”

entradas.text: “Who do you want to travel with, Mr. President?”
“Lucian, come ride with me.”
entradas.menu: “Lucian, come ride with me.”

entradas.text: “This isn't necessary, but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”
“As you wish. I'll see you in Arvory.”
I revved the engine. Lucian waved at the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.
I revved the engine. Symon smiled awkwardly at the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.
I revved the engine. Lileas waved to the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.
I revved the engine and waved to the press photographers as I drove onto the new highway.
The new highway was in pristine condition. The ride to Arvory was the smoothest I'd ever had.
After an uneventful four hours, we were welcomed by a throng of Arvory citizens and Mayor Eric Niel.
“On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”
“I think all of us are.”
“Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”
“Things were certainly easier back then.”
“Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank everyone involved in the H-3.”
“Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entradas.menu: “Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entradas.text: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entradas.text: “The people have been waiting a long time for this."
Lileas continued to speak about the strength that comes from unity and the positive change the highway would bring to Agnland.
Symon continued to speak about how this project was a stepping stone towards a Sordish economic recovery.
The crowd began cheering my name.
The weather was warm and unusually calm for the windy port city. Spirits were high.
Despite Lachaven's strong PFJP presence, a huge crowd of supporters had turned out. Lucian must have brought in some ringers.
“I welcome you Lachaveners today as a proud servant of this country.”
“This project is a perfect example of the capacity and capabilities of Sordland as a nation.”
“Our aim with this project was obvious: to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”
Symon handed me a pair of oversized scissors.
“The drive to Arvory should take about four hours. We'll be right behind you in the motorcade.”
Lucian stood up.
“First of all...”
“This day may have arrived later than expected, but it doesn't change the fact that we are here now.”
“We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”
entradas.menu: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”

entradas.text: I silently nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: “To many more projects like this.”
“I have a plan for how to do that.”
“Good work.”
entradas.menu: “Good work.”

entradas.text: “Indeed.”
“It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. From a public relations viewpoint, we can certainly capitalize on the occasion.”
“Let's move on to our plans for the opening tomorrow.”
“Well done.”
“The president himself shall make the maiden voyage from Lachaven to Arvory along with his motorcade. If he agrees, of course."
“What are your thoughts?”
“I think so too. Mr. President?”
“I guess we can't avoid that.”
entradas.menu: “I guess we can't avoid that.”

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “We will need to show our best face tomorrow. I'll make sure that our focus on improving business and logistics is relayed by whatever means necessary.”
“See you at the ceremony.”
entradas.menu: “See you at the ceremony.”

entradas.text: “Goodbye for now.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye for now.”

entradas.text: “Once again, good work everyone.”
entradas.menu: “Once again, good work everyone.”

entradas.text: After he was done with his speech, Lucian took Symon's place on the stage to close the ceremony.
Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.
After she was done with her speech, Lucian took Lileas's place on the stage to close the ceremony.
“Citizens of Lachaven! There you have it!”
“As promised, Anton Rayne -- the 4th President of Sordland -- has delivered!”
We walked towards the entrance of the highway next to the stage.
“Fellow Free Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Fellow Free Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: Although the delay had taken its toll on our morale, it was still a proud moment for all of us.
“This is still a big success. Congratulations, everyone.”
“Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good opportunity to talk about the election campaign preparations.”
